notes: The operands are captured in written order into ReportModel.Controls and emitted in that order as AddControl calls, so index 0 is the major control and the last is the minor. The golden proves the ordering behaviourally: its first operand CX(1:3) is the level whose footing prints last at a break and whose SUM covers both minor groups, while its second operand CX(4:) breaks on its own. retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Reports.cs#BindReportDescriptionClauses (kb/Work PB2357 split DataBinder.Reports.cs: the same code, unchanged, now lives in ReportSectionBinder.cs (the binder), ReportModel.cs (the model types) and ReportScope.cs (the visible-report lookups))
